title: Constructing Robust Emotional State-based Feature with a Novel Voting Scheme for Multi-modal Deception Detection in Videos
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'deception detection,' a task that inherently deals with moral and ethical concepts such as truthfulness, deceit, guilt, and innocence. Its applications are explicitly tied to jurisprudence, law enforcement, national security, and personal/public safety, all of which are fundamentally concerned with ethical behavior and justice.
